name: Hagen the Smith
text: A broad, scarred smith who forges for anyone who pays, and asks no questions about the metal they bring.

name: Ilsa Coldforge
text: She works cold iron the old way, and buys whatever strange parts come down the road.

name: Grashna Ironhand
text: An orc smith of an old breed who forged for a lieutenant's legion. She is free now, and she charges like it.

name: Nibbet Coilwright
text: A gnome artificer who can coax the Dark Lord's machines back to life. Nobody asks what she made for him.
